posts.author: Guardinthena
posts.body:
I just opened up a thread yesterday about discussing one menu layout of a Gunslinger/Mechanist Class I am building. The responses I got back were so thoughtful that I realized I needed to open a proper thread up to discuss how to build this class where it can be unique in its own way, and not just another generic class build. Looking for additional design builds, ideas and insights.
The arcane Mechanist/Gunslinger class I am trying to build focuses on magic infused pistols and hammers with the ability to Attune the magic within the weapons to do different elemental attacks.  This ability can be shared among the party.
Skills this far:
*Attunement: choice to choose between Fire, Voltic, Ice. (Per some great advice I got yesterday, I have limited the Arcane Mechanist choice of elements down to three, and am using SumRandomDudes Skill Extender plugin so I don't have to clutter up the menu).  The Attunement skill ends at the end of battle or when the Attunement is changed.  It is Instant Cast (per Yanflys plugins) so it will not take a turn of combat can can be used on other party members.
*The Arcane Mechanist does additional damage against machine enemies.
*Quick Draw: (pistol) tiny 1% chance to KO target
* Double Tap: (pistol) hits a single target twice.  Again, tiny 1% chance to KO target
* Head Shot: (pistol/rifle) massive damage and 10% to KO target
* Barrage: hits six random targets
* Smoke Bomb: effects whole battlefield using Yanflys plugins, debuffs enemies and parties Accuracy, but increases Evasion rate.
* Molotov Cocktail (not sure what to call this one): Arcane Mechanist uses potions as AOE bombs to hit targets.  Uses Yanflys plugins for Rows and Area of Effects and Skills Require Items.  Great if the player has an excess of potions they don't care about, as they can be used as explosive bombs.
*Summon Machine: Using SumRandomDudes Summon plugin, I am going to add in the ability for the Arcane Mechanist to summon in a mechanical ally in combat.
--
That's all I have currently.  I still need to come up with a skill or two for his hammer, and as of recently, the character in general has gained a arcane mechanical eye, arm and legs.  Not sure how or if these should affect his skills.
As of currently, the majority of his skills require items to work, his pistols require mana shards, the bombs need potions or smoke bombs to work.  And then there is his Attunement ability to grant weapons one of three elemental attributes that he can share with the party.
As he stands, I was curious if the class is unique and distinct in itself already, or if there are other ways I could make the class stand out?

It's like the Glintslinger and Glinventor in my system wrapped into a single class (glint is the word for magic in my setting), so I'm interested in how yours will turn out and the resulting similarities and differences between our respective versions (convergent ideas are an interesting phenomenon), so I'll always be up to throw down some feedback
.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Guardinthena said:
* Smoke Bomb: effects whole battlefield using Yanflys plugins, debuffs enemies and parties Accuracy, but increases Evasion rate.
Click to expand...
Are you sure you want to do both? It seems like it could make a chunk of battle just be a frustrating series of misses, unless you have a good number of magic hit/certain hit skills to use through the smoke.
Guardinthena said:
* Molotov Cocktail (not sure what to call this one):
Click to expand...
You could do something based on alchemy - Alchemical Repurposing, or Alchemy Bomb or something.
Guardinthena said:
As he stands, I was curious if the class is unique and distinct in itself already, or if there are other ways I could make the class stand out?
Click to expand...
Just a suggestion based on that last skill - rather than it being a one-off thing, you might consider a series of skills that use other consumables for different effects.
I don't know if this strays too far from your class vision toward making a separate alchemist class, but repurposing potions into bombs, maybe spending two potions at a time for a bigger heal, flipping an antidote into something that poisons the enemy troop, etc.
